name: Make white matter mask in dwi space from Freesurfer (dtiinit)
summary: Creates a white matter mask in DWI space from a FreeSurfer aparc+aseg segmentation, using the aligned DWI of a dtiInit output as reference, with FreeSurfer mri_label2vol and mri_binarize.
description: Same as the DWI variant, but takes the reference image from a dtiInit output (files.alignedDwRaw in dt6.json): aparc+aseg.mgz is resampled onto that grid by header and white matter, cerebellar white matter, corpus callosum, brainstem and subcortical labels are binarized. The FreeSurfer anatomy must be in the same ACPC space as the dtiInit-aligned DWI. Requires a FreeSurfer license.

inputs.description: FreeSurfer recon-all output; mri/aparc+aseg.mgz is used.
dtiInit output directory; its aligned DWI (dt6.json files.alignedDwRaw) defines the output mask space.
inputs.requirements: Must be aligned with the FreeSurfer anatomy; no registration is computed.

outputs.description: Binary mask in DWI voxel space covering FreeSurfer aparc+aseg white matter, cerebellar white matter, corpus callosum, brainstem and subcortical structures (thalamus, caudate, putamen, pallidum, hippocampus, amygdala, ventral DC).

citations.text: Dale AM, Fischl B, Sereno MI. Cortical surface-based analysis. I. Segmentation and surface reconstruction. NeuroImage 9:179-194 (1999).

Avesani P, McPherson B, Hayashi S, et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).

failure_modes.fix: Check that the FreeSurfer directory contains mri/aparc+aseg.mgz and the dtiInit dt6.json is present.
